name: Magma Queen

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Scorching Wave
abilities.description: The Magma Queen sends a trail of flame forward, indicated by a long red rectangle, dealing high flame damage.

abilities.name: Summon Daedra
abilities.description: Occasionally during the fight, a red portal appears on the outer edge of the arena, conjuring a group of Scamps to join the fight. When the Magma Queen is at 50% health and below, this spawning now also includes a Daedroth alongside the scamps.

abilities.name: Summon Iron Atronach
abilities.description: Occasionally during the fight, an Iron Atronach will emerge out of the lava to join the fight.

abilities.name: Volcano
abilities.description: The Magma Queen sinks into the ground and reemerges at a different location in the arena, creating a pit of molten lava beneath her which spews rocks at nearby target, dealing moderate flame damage each. To seal the pit, kill the Iron Atronach and use the lump of rock they leave behind to throw it at the pit, using the "Rock Toss" synergy. After doing so, the Magma Queen is stunned for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Molten Sweep
abilities.description: This ability starts being used once the Magma Queen reaches 50% health. Two giant walls of flames form on the outer edge of the arena and glide across the arena, though they don't have an AoE indicator. Getting hit by them deals high flame damage and knocks down. These can either be linked together side by side or come from two different directions individually.
